tasks.label: Build WOOTANG
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $workspace = '${workspaceFolder}'; $programFilesX86 = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86'); $vswhere = Join-Path $programFilesX86 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $vswhere)) { throw 'vswhere.exe was not found. Install Visual Studio with Desktop development with C++.' }; $vs = & $vswhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath; if (-not $vs) { throw 'No Visual Studio installation with the C++ x64 tools was found.' }; $devCmd = Join-Path $vs 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'; if (-not (Test-Path $devCmd)) { throw "MSVC environment script not found: $devCmd" }; $build = 'call "' + $devCmd + '" && cl.exe /nologo /W4 /TC /I"' + $workspace + '\include" /Fe"' + $workspace + '\wootang.exe" "' + $workspace + '\wootang.c" /link /LIBPATH:"' + $workspace + '\lib" wooting_analog_sdk_dist.dll.lib user32.lib'; & cmd.exe /d /s /c $build; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Generate Assembly Listing
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $workspace = '${workspaceFolder}'; $source = '${file}'; if ([IO.Path]::GetExtension($source) -ne '.c') { throw 'Open a C source file before generating an assembly listing.' }; $include = Join-Path $workspace 'include'; $assembly = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($source, '.asm'); $programFilesX86 = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86'); $vswhere = Join-Path $programFilesX86 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $vswhere)) { throw 'vswhere.exe was not found. Install Visual Studio with Desktop development with C++.' }; $vs = & $vswhere -latest -products '*' -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath; if (-not $vs) { throw 'No Visual Studio installation with the C++ x64 tools was found.' }; $devCmd = Join-Path $vs 'VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat'; if (-not (Test-Path $devCmd)) { throw "MSVC environment script not found: $devCmd" }; $build = 'call "' + $devCmd + '" && cl.exe /nologo /O2 /FAs /c /TC /I"' + $include + '" /Fa"' + $assembly + '" "' + $source + '"'; & cmd.exe /d /s /c $build; exit $LASTEXITCODE
